user.title: Log in to Posten
user.description:
1. Open this link in a browser and log in with BankID:

{authorize_url}

2. After logging in, your browser is redirected to an address starting with `posten://login?code=...`. The page may fail to open — that is expected.

3. Copy that whole address (or just the `code` value) and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: The authorization code was rejected. Please try logging in again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Posten. Check your connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Posten account is already set up.
